entries.en: Ackerson left the flowers in water while looking for a vase.
entries.zh: 阿克森找花瓶时，先把花放在了水里。

entries.en: Acklen offered to mend the torn pocket before the trip.
entries.zh: 阿克伦提出，愿意在出发前补好撕破的口袋。

entries.en: Ackley found an old cinema ticket inside the borrowed novel.
entries.zh: 阿克利在借来的小说里发现了一张旧电影票。

entries.en: Ackman waited beneath the awning until the heavy rain eased.
entries.zh: 阿克曼在雨篷下等着，直到大雨减弱。

entries.en: Acly packed the chess pieces separately from the folding board.
entries.zh: 阿克利把棋子与折叠棋盘分开装好了。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the Actonel package against the prescription.
entries.zh: 药剂师把Actonel的包装与处方核对了一遍。

entries.en: Acuff pulled a second chair closer so we could share the map.
entries.zh: 阿卡夫把另一把椅子拉近，好让我们一起看地图。

entries.en: Aczel carried the wet painting by its wooden frame.
entries.zh: 奥采尔握着木框，搬动那幅还没干的画。

entries.en: The family kept the photographs they had taken in Adachi.
entries.zh: 这家人保存着他们在安达拍的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 阿代尔斯维尔〔美国地名〕
entries.en: We reached Adairsville just before our phone battery died.
entries.zh: 我们刚到阿代尔斯维尔，手机电池就没电了。

entries.en: Adalbert refused the largest slice and asked for a smaller one.
entries.zh: 阿德尔伯特谢绝了最大的那块，请人换成小一点的。

entries.en: Adamec held the pages flat while I copied the drawing.
entries.zh: 我临摹图画时，阿达梅茨帮忙把书页按平。

entries.en: Adamkus put the muddy football outside before entering the kitchen.
entries.zh: 阿达姆库斯进厨房前，先把沾泥的足球放在了外面。

entries.meaningZh: 亚当斯维尔〔加拿大地名〕
entries.en: My friend's parcel from Adamsville contained the scarf I had forgotten.
entries.zh: 朋友从亚当斯维尔寄来的包裹里，装着我忘拿的围巾。

entries.en: Adato listened carefully before deciding which instrument needed tuning.
entries.zh: 阿达托仔细听过，才判断哪件乐器需要调音。

entries.en: Addabbo left space on the shelf for the taller bottles.
entries.zh: 阿达博在架子上给较高的瓶子留出了空间。

entries.en: She asked the pharmacist to explain the leaflet supplied with Adderall.
entries.zh: 她请药剂师解释随Adderall附带的说明书。

entries.en: Our time in Adderley passed faster than the long journey there.
entries.zh: 我们在阿德利的时光，过得比前往那里的漫长旅程快得多。

entries.en: Addicks brought a spare apron for the volunteer who had forgotten hers.
entries.zh: 阿迪克斯给那位忘带围裙的女志愿者带来了一条备用的。

entries.en: Addicott stood back to judge whether the picture was hanging straight.
entries.zh: 阿迪科特退后，看看画挂得正不正。

entries.en: The envelope from Addo arrived with one corner badly crushed.
entries.zh: 从阿多寄来的信封有一角压得很厉害。

entries.en: Addonizio tucked the receipt into his wallet before leaving the shop.
entries.zh: 阿多尼西奥离开商店前，把收据塞进了钱包。

entries.en: Adeli caught the scarf before the wind carried it away.
entries.zh: 阿德利赶在围巾被风吹走之前抓住了它。

entries.en: Adelmann moved the chessboard away from the edge of the table.
entries.zh: 阿德尔曼把棋盘从桌子边缘移开了。

entries.meaningZh: 阿德尔斯海姆〔德国地名〕
entries.en: We sent a thank-you letter to our host in Adelsheim.
entries.zh: 我们给在阿德尔斯海姆接待我们的人寄了一封感谢信。

entries.en: Adelstein checked the spelling of every guest's name before printing the cards.
entries.zh: 印卡片前，阿德尔斯坦检查了每位客人姓名的拼写。

entries.en: The museum's new gallery prompted her to read more about Adena culture.
entries.zh: 博物馆的新展厅促使她进一步阅读有关阿登那文化的资料。

entries.en: Aderhold found the lost earring caught in the woollen scarf.
entries.zh: 阿德霍尔德发现，丢失的耳环勾在了羊毛围巾里。

entries.en: Adey quietly replaced the noisy chair before the recording began.
entries.zh: 录音开始前，阿迪悄悄换掉了那把会响的椅子。

entries.en: Adger took the shorter route to avoid carrying the suitcase upstairs.
entries.zh: 阿杰走了较短的路线，免得把行李箱提上楼梯。

entries.en: We were still discussing our visit to Adjara when the taxi arrived.
entries.zh: 出租车到来时，我们还在讨论去阿贾拉的那次行程。

entries.en: The letter reached Adjumani after its recipient had already left.
entries.zh: 信寄到阿朱马尼时，收信人已经离开了。

entries.en: Adkinson recognised the melody despite the badly tuned piano.
entries.zh: 尽管钢琴走调得厉害，阿德金森还是听出了曲调。

entries.en: Adkisson offered the child a choice between two storybooks.
entries.zh: 阿基森让那个孩子从两本故事书中选一本。

entries.en: Adlai brought a blanket for the long wait outside.
entries.zh: 阿德莱带了一条毯子，准备在外面长时间等候。

entries.en: Adleman tested the zip before putting the sleeping bag away.
entries.zh: 阿德尔曼试了试拉链，才把睡袋收起来。

entries.en: Adlington checked beneath the cushions before accusing the dog of hiding the sock.
entries.zh: 阿德林顿先检查了靠垫下面，才怪那只狗藏起了袜子。

entries.en: Adoniram opened the curtains without waking the sleeping child.
entries.zh: 阿多奈拉姆拉开窗帘，没有吵醒熟睡的孩子。

entries.en: Adriance lent me a ruler to measure the damaged photograph.
entries.zh: 阿德里安斯借给我一把尺子，让我量那张受损的照片。

entries.en: Adrianne suggested singing the difficult section more slowly.
entries.zh: 阿德里安娜建议，把难唱的那段唱慢一点。

entries.meaningZh: 阿杜阿〔印度尼西亚地名〕
entries.en: We had no room for extra luggage on the journey to Adua.
entries.zh: 前往阿杜阿的途中，我们没有地方再放额外行李。

entries.en: Adubato covered the cake before the curious cat reached it.
entries.zh: 好奇的猫还没碰到蛋糕，阿杜巴托就先把蛋糕罩住了。

entries.meaningZh: 阿杜瓦〔埃塞俄比亚地名〕
entries.en: The diary's final pages describe the writer's arrival in Aduwa.
entries.zh: 日记的最后几页描述了作者抵达阿杜瓦的经历。

entries.en: Aebersold made room on the bench for my heavy bag.
entries.zh: 埃伯索尔德在长凳上给我的重包腾出了地方。

entries.en: Aengus returned the borrowed coat with all its buttons sewn back on.
entries.zh: 安格斯归还借来的外套时，所有纽扣都已重新缝好。

entries.meaningZh: 阿法贝特〔厄立特里亚地名〕
entries.en: The package for Afabet was heavier than we had expected.
entries.zh: 那件寄往阿法贝特的包裹，比我们预想的更重。

entries.en: Affeldt brought the forgotten music stand just before rehearsal.
entries.zh: 阿费尔特在排练开始前刚好把忘带的谱架送来了。

entries.en: Mrs Affleck smiled when the children offered to wash the dishes.
entries.zh: 孩子们主动提出洗碗时，阿弗莱克夫人笑了。

entries.en: Afifi kept the puppy away from the freshly painted fence.
entries.zh: 阿菲菲不让小狗靠近刚刷好漆的篱笆。

entries.en: Our friends in Afikpo sent a parcel full of family photographs.
entries.zh: 阿菲波的朋友们给我们寄来了一包家庭照片。

entries.en: We reached Afon carrying far more food than we needed.
entries.zh: 我们到达阿丰时，带着远超所需的食物。

entries.en: Her notebook from Agadez still held the pressed flower I remembered.
entries.zh: 她那本从阿加德兹来的笔记本里，还夹着我记得的那朵压花。

entries.en: We spent our last hour in Agawam searching for the car keys.
entries.zh: 我们在阿格瓦姆的最后一个小时，全花在找车钥匙上。

entries.en: She spent the afternoon repairing her scale model of Agena.
entries.zh: 她用了一下午修理阿金纳火箭上面级的比例模型。

entries.en: Ageton noticed a tear in the tent before the rain began.
entries.zh: 还没开始下雨，阿吉顿就发现帐篷破了一处。

entries.en: Agey offered to carry the cage while I held the door.
entries.zh: 我扶着门时，阿吉主动提出搬笼子。

entries.en: Aggrey set an empty bowl beneath the leaking pipe.
entries.zh: 阿格雷在漏水的管子下面放了一只空碗。

entries.en: Aggy sang softly while winding the wool into a ball.
entries.zh: 阿吉一边把毛线绕成团，一边轻声唱歌。

entries.en: Agnello asked us to keep the doorway clear for the dancers.
entries.zh: 阿涅洛请我们保持门口畅通，方便舞者进出。

entries.en: Agnellus placed a bookmark beside the passage he wanted to discuss.
entries.zh: 阿格内勒斯在想讨论的那段文字旁放了一张书签。

entries.en: Agnich returned for the umbrella she had left beneath the table.
entries.zh: 阿格尼奇回来取她落在桌子下面的伞。

entries.en: Agno inspected the folded map before deciding where to stop.
entries.zh: 阿格诺查看折起来的地图，才决定在哪里停下。

entries.en: We had to shorten our stay in Agnone when the suitcase went missing.
entries.zh: 行李箱不见后，我们不得不缩短在阿尼奥内的停留。

entries.en: Agnus noticed the child's drawing pinned behind the calendar.
entries.zh: 阿格纳斯发现，日历后面钉着那个孩子的画。

entries.en: Agogino tied the loose ribbon before stepping onto the stage.
entries.zh: 走上舞台前，阿戈吉诺系好了松开的丝带。

entries.en: Agosta left a note explaining where the spare blankets were kept.
entries.zh: 阿戈斯塔留了张便条，说明备用毯子放在哪里。

entries.en: Agrawal found the right screwdriver beneath a pile of old brushes.
entries.zh: 阿格拉沃尔在一堆旧刷子下面找到了合适的螺丝刀。

entries.en: Agresto put his glasses away before jumping into the pool.
entries.zh: 阿格雷斯托收好眼镜，才跳进泳池。

entries.en: Agronsky cleared the table so the children could spread out their paintings.
entries.zh: 阿格龙斯基清空了桌子，让孩子们能把画摊开。

entries.en: We posted the forgotten book back to our friends in Aguada.
entries.zh: 我们把忘拿的书寄回给了阿瓜达的朋友们。

entries.en: She packed extra sketchbooks for the week in Aguadulce.
entries.zh: 她为在阿瓜杜尔塞的一周多带了几本速写本。

entries.en: Aguilar removed the fallen leaves from the birdbath.
entries.zh: 阿圭勒清理掉了鸟浴盆里的落叶。

entries.meaningZh: 阿吉拉雷斯〔阿根廷地名〕
entries.en: The letter from Aguilares arrived on the day we moved house.
entries.zh: 从阿吉拉雷斯寄来的信，在我们搬家的那天到了。

entries.en: Our photograph from Agulhas disappeared among the papers during the move.
entries.zh: 我们在厄加勒斯拍的照片，搬家时混在文件里不见了。

entries.meaningZh: 美国家电制造商协会〔机构名〕
entries.en: Our team sent AHAM a question about the appliance survey.
entries.zh: 我们团队向美国家电制造商协会提出了一个有关家电调查的问题。

entries.en: Mr Ahearne stayed behind to help fold the tables.
entries.zh: 阿亨先生留下来帮忙收起折叠桌。

entries.en: Ms Aherne discovered that the new curtains were too short.
entries.zh: 阿亨女士发现，新窗帘太短了。

entries.en: Ahlers steadied the bicycle while the child climbed onto the seat.
entries.zh: 孩子爬上车座时，阿勒斯扶稳了自行车。

entries.en: Ahlgren left the muddy gardening gloves beside the back door.
entries.zh: 阿尔格伦把沾泥的园艺手套留在了后门旁。

entries.en: Ahlquist asked for a quieter room before recording the interview.
entries.zh: 录制访谈前，阿尔奎斯特要求换一个更安静的房间。

entries.en: Ahlstrom held the parcel carefully because one corner was wet.
entries.zh: 阿尔斯特伦小心地拿着包裹，因为有一角湿了。

entries.en: Ahmanson practised the final sentence until he could say it without pausing.
entries.zh: 阿曼森反复练习最后一句，直到能不停顿地说出来。

entries.meaningZh: 艾哈迈达巴德〔印度地名〕
entries.en: We remembered our week in Ahmedabad whenever we opened the photograph album.
entries.zh: 每次翻开相册，我们都会想起在艾哈迈达巴德的那一周。

entries.en: The box we left in Ahoskie contained all the winter coats.
entries.zh: 我们留在阿霍斯基的那个箱子里装着所有冬季外套。

entries.en: Our visit to Ahram ended with an unexpected invitation to stay longer.
entries.zh: 我们在阿赫拉姆的那次拜访结束时，意外收到邀请，请我们多住些日子。

entries.en: Ahren offered me a dry towel after the boat trip.
entries.zh: 乘船旅程结束后，阿伦提出给我一条干毛巾。

entries.en: Ahrendt set the bread aside so it would not get crushed.
entries.zh: 阿伦特把面包放到一边，免得压坏。

entries.en: Aiden volunteered to carry the books up the narrow stairs.
entries.zh: 艾登主动提出，把书搬上狭窄的楼梯。

entries.en: Aigner examined the broken hinge before reaching for a tool.
entries.zh: 艾格纳查看了坏铰链，才伸手去拿工具。

entries.en: Aikins checked the empty stage for anything the musicians had forgotten.
entries.zh: 艾金斯在空舞台上检查，看乐手们有没有忘拿东西。

entries.en: Dr Aikman returned the borrowed suitcase with a new luggage tag.
entries.zh: 艾克曼博士归还借来的行李箱时，给它配上了一个新行李牌。

entries.en: Ailes found a pair of dry socks at the bottom of the bag.
entries.zh: 艾尔斯在包底找到了一双干袜子。

entries.en: Ailey moved the lamp so I could see the stitching clearly.
entries.zh: 艾利移动了灯，让我能看清缝线。

entries.en: Ailie persuaded the tired children to put their toys away.
entries.zh: 艾莉说服了疲倦的孩子们，把玩具收起来。

entries.en: Aine kept the glass ornaments beyond the kitten's reach.
entries.zh: 安妮把玻璃饰物放在了小猫够不到的地方。

entries.en: Ainslee offered to carry the heavy stand while I took the violin.
entries.zh: 我拿小提琴时，安斯利主动提出搬那个重架子。

entries.en: Mrs Ainsley found the children's footprints in the wet cement.
entries.zh: 安斯利夫人在湿水泥里发现了孩子们的脚印。

entries.meaningZh: 美国—以色列公共事务委员会〔机构名〕
entries.en: The journalist sent AIPAC a written request for an interview.
entries.zh: 那位记者向美国—以色列公共事务委员会递交了一份书面采访请求。

entries.en: Airhart turned the photograph over to check the date on the back.
entries.zh: 艾尔哈特把照片翻过来，查看背面的日期。

entries.en: We left Airola carrying a borrowed umbrella and a bag of sandwiches.
entries.zh: 我们离开艾罗拉时，带着一把借来的伞和一袋三明治。

entries.en: Aisenberg packed the small drum between two thick blankets.
entries.zh: 艾森伯格把小鼓夹在两条厚毯子之间装好了。

entries.en: Aisha held the torch while I searched beneath the bed.
entries.zh: 我在床底下找东西时，艾莎举着手电筒。

entries.meaningZh: 艾塔佩〔巴布亚新几内亚地名〕
entries.en: The postcard from Aitape arrived long after our friend returned home.
entries.zh: 从艾塔佩寄来的明信片，在朋友回家很久后才到。

entries.en: Mr Aitkin tied the loose shoelace before the race began.
entries.zh: 艾特金先生在比赛开始前系好了松开的鞋带。

entries.meaningZh: 普罗旺斯地区艾克斯〔法国城市名〕
entries.en: We spent our final afternoon in Aix-en-Provence writing postcards.
entries.zh: 在普罗旺斯地区艾克斯的最后一个下午，我们都在写明信片。

entries.en: Aiyar noticed the cracked cup before pouring the tea.
entries.zh: 艾亚尔倒茶前发现，杯子裂了。

entries.meaningZh: 艾耶托罗〔尼日利亚地名〕
entries.en: We reached Aiyetoro with enough daylight left to unpack the car.
entries.zh: 我们到达艾耶托罗时，天还亮着，来得及把车上的行李卸下来。

entries.en: We borrowed Ajami for a film discussion that ran late into the evening.
entries.zh: 我们借来《阿亚米》进行电影讨论，一直讨论到很晚。

entries.meaningZh: 阿卡杰姆戈罗多克〔俄罗斯地名〕
entries.en: The parcel we sent to Akademgorodok contained the missing camera lens.
entries.zh: 我们寄往阿卡杰姆戈罗多克的包裹里，装着那枚不见的相机镜头。

entries.en: Akaka checked the sewing basket before buying more thread.
entries.zh: 阿卡卡先检查了针线篮，才去买更多线。

entries.en: She saved the photographs from Akara in a separate album.
entries.zh: 她把在阿卡拉拍的照片保存在一本单独的相册里。

entries.en: I met my old teacher in Akasaka by complete chance.
entries.zh: 我完全偶然地在赤坂遇到了以前的老师。

entries.en: Akenson caught the hat before it rolled into the road.
entries.zh: 埃肯森赶在帽子滚到路上之前抓住了它。

entries.en: Akerman moved the lunch indoors when the wind scattered the napkins.
entries.zh: 风吹散了餐巾，阿克曼便把午餐移到了室内。

entries.en: The book club read an Akhmatova poem aloud before discussing its translation.
entries.zh: 读书俱乐部先朗读了一首阿赫马托娃的诗，随后讨论它的译文。

entries.en: Akhund lent me a thick book to press the curled paper flat.
entries.zh: 阿洪德借给我一本厚书，让我把卷曲的纸压平。

entries.en: Our friends in Akosombo asked us to bring the photograph album.
entries.zh: 阿科松博的朋友们请我们带上相册。

entries.en: Ms Akroyd apologised for mistaking my umbrella for hers.
entries.zh: 阿克罗伊德女士把我的伞错当成自己的，为此道了歉。

entries.meaningZh: 阿克萨卡尔〔土耳其地名〕
entries.en: A message from Aksakal reached us just as we were loading the car.
entries.zh: 我们正往车上装行李时，一条从阿克萨卡尔发来的消息到了。

entries.en: A letter from Aksay arrived while we were packing for the move.
entries.zh: 我们正为搬家收拾东西时，一封从阿克赛寄来的信到了。

entries.en: Akst held the door open while the musicians carried in their cases.
entries.zh: 乐手们把乐器盒搬进来时，阿克斯特撑着门。

entries.meaningZh: 阿克塔斯〔哈萨克斯坦地名〕
entries.en: The box from Aktas contained a fragile wooden model.
entries.zh: 从阿克塔斯寄来的箱子里装着一个易碎的木制模型。

entries.meaningZh: 阿库雷〔尼日利亚城市名〕
entries.en: My friend in Akure returned the scarf I had left behind.
entries.zh: 阿库雷的朋友把我忘拿的围巾还了回来。

entries.en: Alaback lifted the tablecloth to check for the missing fork.
entries.zh: 阿拉巴克掀起桌布，寻找那把不见的叉子。

entries.en: We posted the borrowed books back to our friends in Alabam.
entries.zh: 我们把借来的书寄还给了阿拉巴姆的朋友们。

entries.en: Alaimo carefully removed the fallen moth from the lampshade.
entries.zh: 阿莱莫小心地把落在灯罩上的飞蛾移走了。

entries.en: Alaina kept the handwritten recipe in a waterproof sleeve.
entries.zh: 阿莱娜把手写食谱放在了防水套里。

entries.en: Alala offered to watch the bags while we bought lunch.
entries.zh: 我们去买午饭时，阿拉拉主动提出看着行李。

entries.en: Our photograph from Alamosa was damaged when the envelope got wet.
entries.zh: 信封湿了，里面那张我们在阿拉莫萨拍的照片也受了损。

entries.en: Alanson moved the cat gently before sitting down at the piano.
entries.zh: 阿兰森轻轻把猫移到一旁，才在钢琴前坐下。

entries.en: Alarie asked us not to stack the plates too high.
entries.zh: 阿拉里请我们别把盘子叠得太高。

entries.en: We brought home a sketch we had made during our stay in Alata.
entries.zh: 我们把在阿拉塔停留期间画的一幅速写带回了家。

entries.en: Alaya noticed the faded signature in the corner of the painting.
entries.zh: 阿拉亚注意到了画角落里那个褪色的签名。

entries.en: She painted Lake Albano from a photograph her father had taken.
entries.zh: 她根据父亲拍的一张照片，画了阿尔巴诺湖。

entries.en: Albaugh offered the guest a cushion for the hard wooden chair.
entries.zh: 阿尔博提出给客人一个坐垫，垫在那把坚硬的木椅上。

entries.en: Albeck folded the empty paper bags for another day's shopping.
entries.zh: 阿尔贝克把空纸袋折好，留待改天购物时再用。

entries.en: Alben paused the music so we could hear the visitor at the door.
entries.zh: 阿尔本暂停了音乐，让我们能听清门口访客的声音。

entries.en: Albeniz kept the puppy entertained while we cleaned the kitchen.
entries.zh: 我们打扫厨房时，阿尔贝尼兹逗着小狗玩。

entries.en: Alber found the torn page caught beneath the rug.
entries.zh: 阿伯发现，那张破损的书页压在地毯下面。

entries.en: Alberg brought a smaller saucepan because the cupboard was nearly full.
entries.zh: 橱柜快满了，阿尔伯格便带来了一只较小的煮锅。

entries.en: Alberic took the long handle so I could lift the other end.
entries.zh: 阿尔伯里克抓住长把手，让我抬另一端。

entries.en: Alberthal noticed that the new lampshade touched the curtain.
entries.zh: 艾伯索尔发现，新灯罩碰到了窗帘。

entries.en: Albertson stayed near the stage in case the children needed help.
entries.zh: 艾伯森守在舞台附近，以便孩子们需要时帮忙。

entries.en: We reached Albia with the birthday cake still safely in its box.
entries.zh: 我们到达阿尔比亚时，生日蛋糕仍安稳地放在盒子里。

entries.en: Mr Albinson checked the bag twice before admitting he had forgotten the tickets.
entries.zh: 阿尔宾森先生把包检查了两遍，才承认忘带了票。

entries.en: Albro brought enough spare pencils for the entire drawing class.
entries.zh: 奥尔布罗带来的备用铅笔，足够绘画班全体学生使用。

entries.en: Albrook kept the floor clear while the movers carried in the wardrobe.
entries.zh: 搬家工人搬进衣柜时，奥尔布鲁克让地面保持畅通。

entries.en: The letter from Alburquerque included a photograph of our old dog.
entries.zh: 从阿尔布开克寄来的信里，附着一张我们那只老狗的照片。

entries.en: Alchin found the lost ribbon tangled around a chair leg.
entries.zh: 阿尔钦发现，丢失的丝带缠在了一条椅子腿上。

entries.en: We spent our last evening in Alcira sorting photographs for the journey home.
entries.zh: 在阿尔西拉的最后一晚，我们整理照片，准备踏上归途。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔库维耶雷〔西班牙地名〕
entries.en: Our invitation to Alcubierre arrived after we had booked another trip.
entries.zh: 去阿尔库维耶雷的邀请到来时，我们已经预订了另一次旅行。

entries.en: Aldea checked the old coat for holes before giving it away.
entries.zh: 阿尔迪亚把旧外套送人之前，先检查了有没有破洞。

entries.en: We returned to Aldie to collect the bag we had forgotten.
entries.zh: 我们回到奥尔迪，取那只忘拿的包。

entries.en: Aldinger turned the chair around so the child could see the puppets.
entries.zh: 奥尔丁杰把椅子转了过来，让孩子能看见木偶。

entries.en: Aldred left his muddy shoes outside the tent.
entries.zh: 奥尔德雷德把沾泥的鞋留在了帐篷外。

entries.en: Aldredge found a quiet seat away from the rattling window.
entries.zh: 奥尔德雷奇找了个安静座位，远离那扇咔嗒作响的窗户。

entries.en: Aldwyn offered to carry the plant rather than squeeze it into a bag.
entries.zh: 阿尔德温主动提出，手捧那盆植物，不把它硬塞进袋子里。

entries.en: Alegi set a chair beside the bed for the waiting visitor.
entries.zh: 阿莱吉在床边放了一把椅子，给那位等候的访客坐。

entries.en: Aleister balanced the picture frame against the wall before fetching a hook.
entries.zh: 阿莱斯特先把画框靠墙放稳，才去拿挂钩。

entries.meaningZh: 亚历山德罗夫〔俄罗斯地名〕
entries.en: Our friends in Aleksandrov asked us to bring the borrowed camera back.
entries.zh: 亚历山德罗夫的朋友们请我们把借来的相机带回去。

entries.meaningZh: 阿莱克西纳茨〔塞尔维亚地名〕
entries.en: We left Aleksinac earlier than planned because the children were tired.
entries.zh: 孩子们累了，我们便比原计划更早离开了阿莱克西纳茨。

entries.en: The postcard from Aleman had no room left for a return address.
entries.zh: 从阿莱曼寄来的明信片上，已经没有地方写寄信地址了。

entries.en: Alena offered to read the difficult instructions aloud.
entries.zh: 阿莱娜主动提出，把难懂的说明读出来。

entries.en: Alene pinned the torn curtain closed until it could be repaired.
entries.zh: 艾琳用别针把破窗帘别拢，等着以后修补。

entries.meaningZh: 阿连特茹〔葡萄牙地区名〕
entries.en: Our journey through the Alentejo filled three small sketchbooks.
entries.zh: 穿行阿连特茹的旅程，让我们画满了三本小速写本。

entries.meaningZh: 艾烈希〔家用品设计制造商名〕
entries.en: The exhibition paired designs by Alessi with sketches from local students.
entries.zh: 展览把艾烈希的设计与当地学生的草图配在一起展示。

entries.en: Aletha turned the radio down when the baby began to stir.
entries.zh: 婴儿开始动起来时，阿莱莎把收音机音量调低了。

entries.en: Aletheia set aside the chipped cup before serving the tea.
entries.zh: 阿莱西娅把缺口的杯子放到一边，才开始上茶。

entries.en: She borrowed a biography of Alexanderson for her engineering seminar.
entries.zh: 她为工程学研讨课借了一本亚历山德森的传记。

entries.en: Alexandr noticed the red stain before sitting on the cushion.
entries.zh: 亚历山大坐到靠垫上之前，发现了红色污渍。

entries.en: Alexandrina warmed her hands around the mug while listening.
entries.zh: 亚历山德里娜一边听，一边用双手捧着杯子取暖。

entries.en: Alexandro brought a spare shirt for the messy painting activity.
entries.zh: 亚历山德罗为那项容易弄脏衣服的绘画活动带了一件备用衬衫。

entries.en: Alexi checked his pockets before asking whether anyone had seen his keys.
entries.zh: 亚历克西先检查了自己的口袋，才问有没有人看见他的钥匙。

entries.en: Alexius kept one hand on the gate while the dog ran past.
entries.zh: 狗从身旁跑过时，亚历克修斯一直用一只手扶着门。

entries.en: Alfano arranged the empty bottles so none could roll off the shelf.
entries.zh: 阿尔法诺摆好空瓶子，让它们都不会从架子上滚下来。

entries.en: Alfonse waited until the music stopped before knocking again.
entries.zh: 阿方斯等音乐停下后，才再次敲门。

entries.en: We spent the journey to Alfonsine comparing our unfinished drawings.
entries.zh: 前往阿方西内的途中，我们一直在比较各自没画完的画。

entries.en: Alfven put the sleeping puppy into a basket lined with towels.
entries.zh: 阿尔文把熟睡的小狗放进了垫着毛巾的篮子里。

entries.en: The parcel we sent from Algarrobo arrived before we returned home.
entries.zh: 我们从阿尔加罗沃寄出的包裹，比我们先到了家。
